description: Reads recently watched media from Plex, Jellyfin, or Emby, finds similar titles via TMDb or an LLM, and sends requests to Seer. Includes scheduling, approval controls, filters, and cleanup automation.
tagline: Recommendations from your watch history, straight to Seer.
author: WisdomSky

tips.before_install: The first-run wizard asks for a TMDb API key and your media server and Seer details. Back up `/DATA/AppData/suggestarr/config_files` before updates.

title: SuggestArr
